    //==
    // The IMesh3D obligation of every typed solid is the derived
    // ToTriangleMesh(IPolygonMesh3D) in `meshes-polygon.library.plato`: each one
    // triangulates through its own polygon mesh by fan triangulation.

    //==
    // # Deformation bodies for the profile-generated solids
    //
    // The IDeformable3D obligation of the one solid in `solids.types.plato` that
    // is spanned by stored points. Extrude, revolve and sweep are absent: each
    // carries a placement frame, an axis or a path curve, and a point mapping
    // supplies no image for those.

    // Each cross-section deformed in turn; the sections keep their point counts,
    // so the loft's correspondence between them survives, and Closed is a
    // topological flag rather than geometry.
    Deform(self: LoftedSolid, mapping: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>): LoftedSolid
        => (self.Sections.Map(section => section.Deform(mapping)), self.Closed);
}
